summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on a discrepancy regarding the forecast data for company 7930, which was reported as not running correctly at the end of October. Someone provided SQL queries to analyze session data (using `device_session_trusted`) grouped by date and facility number.

A key point of confusion was whether all companies should be included in the aggregated forecast calculation or only a select list. It was clarified that while the calculation is done for everyone, it is not written into the aggregate dataset for every company.
[p1] expressed confusion about this logic and the process of requesting additions.
decisions: The forecast data issue for 7930 needs immediate attention due to an upcoming demo.
action_items: [me] will add company 7930's data (implied follow-up on the SQL analysis).
